title: Nashville Barrel Co: Blend Your Own Whiskey — Bottle Included
blurb: Craft a one-of-a-kind whiskey during a 60-minute blending session at the Nashville Barrel Company. Guided by award-winning experts, taste various whiskey profiles, experiment with different mashbills, and create a unique blend tailored to your palate. Adjust the proof to your liking and leave with a custom-labeled bottle that embodies your personal touch. Perfect for bachelorette parties, anniversaries, or team-building events, this interactive experience ensures each participant walks away with a distinct whiskey that represents their creativity.
